title: Incredible Dumb Tools
description:
A pre-pre-preAlpha Project made by GyrosLord5
with dumb tools
body:
A mod that adds some tools.

**Flame Sword:**
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The Flame Sword looks like This:

![a sword that has a blade made out of Fire and it has a enchantmenr glint](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3091341963fc5a042c92222c98631860f09ab810.png)

The Flame Sword is just like the enchanment Flame but with a cooldown.
The Flame Sword also only has 5 Attack Damage.
But The Flame Sword only needs a Stick and two Magma Blocks

</details>

**Mana Stone:**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
The Mana Stone looks like This:
  
 ![a dark green ball](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7aec03f52b1f87cda5e3c9ee3b60f4b527e108b0.png)
    
With the Mana Stone by itself it can´t do anything, but when combined with
the Flame Sword you get a Advanced Flame Sword.


</details>

**Advanced Flame Sword:**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
The Advanced Flame Sword looks like this:

![same as the normal but it has a stronger glint and on the handle a green dot that resembles the mana stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be0b73e4fb334b7c6e5a3b4fcf85a78593f7bb3f.png)

The Advanced Flame Sword is just like the Flame Sword, 
but it has less Cooldown and the attacked Player/Mob burns longer


</details>
